description: This file contains test helper code for the server package, specifically a stub implementation of package storage used for testing purposes.

classes.name: stubPackageStorage
classes.description: A stub implementation of package storage for testing, maintains an internal map of package IDs to AgentPackage objects and records get calls.

methods.name: newStubPackageStorage
methods.description: Creates and returns a new stubPackageStorage instance with an initialized package map.

methods.name: GetAgentPackage
methods.description: Retrieves an AgentPackage by packageID; records the call and returns the package or an error if not found.

methods.name: StoreAgentPackage
methods.description: Stores an AgentPackage in the internal map keyed by its ID.
